```artifact
# The test suite written in Gherkin (BDD DSL) notation

Feature: Access Control and User Management
  Background: Access to the system is restricted to specified PinCodes (Zones) as set up in the Parameter Control File
  Requirement: System shall be available only on Specified PinCodes (Zones)

  Scenario: Valid access with correct PinCode
    Given a user attempts to access the system with a correct PinCode
    When the user provides valid login credentials
    Then the system grants access and proceeds to the login screen

Scenario Outline: Access with incorrect PinCode
  It is expected that the system denies access and prompts for the correct PinCode
    Given a user attempts to access the system with an incorrect PinCode
    When the user provides invalid PinCode
    Then the system denies access and displays an error message

Scenario: Login functionality
  Background: All Users shall access the system using a login/user-id and password
  Requirement: The login-id/password will be managed in a secured manner
  
  # Scenario examples
  Examples:
    | PinCode    | User-id | Password    | Expected Outcome                   |
    | Correct    | Correct  | Correct    | Grants access and proceeds to login |
    | Incorrect  | Correct  | Correct    | Denies access and prompts for correct PinCode |
    | Incorrect  | Incorrect| Correct    | Denies access and displays an error message |

Scenario: Speciality and Doctor linkage
  Background: Each Speciality ‘has’ one or more Doctors linked to it
  Requirement: Each Doctor shall be mapped to ONE and ONLY ONE Speciality
  
  # Scenario examples
  Examples:
    | Speciality | Doctor   | Expected Speciality Association |
    | Cardiology | Dr. Smith | Cardiology   | Correct association |
    | Cardiology | Dr. Jones | Cardiology   | Correct association |
    | Dermatology| Dr. Brown | Dermatology  | Correct association |
    | Dermatology| Dr. White | Not Dermatology | Incorrect association |

Scenario: Patient registration
  Background: Each Patient shall register himself/herself by filling Patient profile
  Requirement: Each Patient has to register himself/herself by filling Patient profile - a unique id will be generated for the Patient
  
  # Scenario examples
  Examples:
    | Patient Info | Expected Patient ID |
    | John Doe    | ID12345         |
    | Jane Roe    | ID12346         |

Scenario: Consultation requests
  Background: Each Patient can request for one or more consultation requests (linked back to Speciality)
  Requirement: Each Doctor shall provide Consultation to ONE or More Patient
  
  # Scenario examples
  Examples:
    | Patient ID | Doctor ID | Expected Consultation Request |
    | ID12345    | ID67890         | Consultation request for Doctor ID |
    | ID12345    | ID54321         | Multiple Consultation requests for Doctor ID |

Scenario: Access with correct credentials
  Background: All Users shall access the system using a login/user-id and password
  Requirement: The login-id/password will be managed in a secured manner
  
  # Scenario examples
  Examples:
    | User-id    | Password    | Expected Secure Access |
    | User1      | Password1    | Secure access granted |
    | User2      | Password2    | Secure access denied (incorrect credentials) |

```
